mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, query_hash AS queryHash, sort_no AS sortNo, price_band_min AS priceBandMin, price_band_max AS priceBandMax, is_open_ended AS isOpenEnded, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM diag_price_band_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND query_hash = #{queryHash} AND is_active = '1' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
